note: Get-by challenges — strategic competence (Canale & Swain). Each gives a real communicative goal you must accomplish with the words you already know, not the 'perfect' word. Success is being understood, not being correct. The model uses only early, high-frequency vocabulary; the AI grades against the learner's actual taught set.

challenges.goal: Tell a waiter you don't eat meat — you don't need the exact word for it.
challenges.hint: Lean on ma … sh (not) plus a verb you know.

challenges.goal: You didn't catch the price. Get them to write it down for you.
challenges.hint: You've learned a phrase for exactly this.

challenges.goal: You feel sick and need a doctor. Make that understood.
A shopkeeper is talking too fast. Ask them to slow down and say it again.
challenges.hint: Two short rescue phrases, back to back.

challenges.goal: You want tea with no sugar, but forget the word for 'sugar'. Get the idea across.
challenges.hint: You can name what you DO want and wave off the rest.
